INTIG_PROGRAM_ID.description: Server-side Intigriti program-scope predicate forwarded as the programId=<uuid> query parameter on GET /external/researcher/v1/submissions. Optional; empty / blank walks the entire token's program scope (the typical operational mode for a single-program identity). Comma-separated ids / handles are split and trimmed, then forwarded as multiple programId=<uuid> entries so a single agent can pull submissions from several programs in one run (e.g. '11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555,acme-prod,acme-mobile'). Intigriti accepts either the program's uuid or its slug (handle); the operator's token scope still applies. Whitespace is trimmed around each entry.

INTIG_STATUS.description: Server-side Intigriti submission-status filter (CSV: 'open' / 'new' / 'triage' / 'triaged' / 'accepted' / 'pending-review' / 'resolved' / 'closed' / 'duplicate' / 'out-of-scope' / 'spam' / 'informative' / 'wont-fix'). Forwarded as repeated statusId=<status> query entries so the operator can compose a multi-status filter (Intigriti accepts either the canonical label or the integer id; the dispatcher forwards the canonical label so a future Intigriti id renumbering does not silently warp the filter). Operator-friendly aliases are normalised ('new' -> 'open', 'open' -> 'open', 'triaging' / 'in-triage' -> 'triage', 'in-progress' -> 'triaged', 'fixed' -> 'resolved', 'pending' -> 'pending-review', 'oos' / 'out_of_scope' / 'outofscope' -> 'out-of-scope', 'dup' -> 'duplicate', 'na' / 'not_applicable' / 'notapplicable' -> 'out-of-scope', 'info' / 'informational' -> 'informative', 'wontfix' / "won't-fix" / 'wont_fix' -> 'wont-fix'). Blank / missing walks every status (the typical operational mode for first-time imports). Unknown / unparseable entries are dropped silently rather than crashing the run.

name: intigriti
title: Intigriti
description: Intigriti crowd-sourced bug-bounty submission importer. Pulls validated submissions from the Intigriti Researcher REST API and emits Faraday bulk-create JSON. Intigriti is a European crowd-sourced security platform — external researchers submit vulnerability reports against a program's scope and the program triages, validates, prioritises, and pays out on the resulting findings. This executor surfaces validated submissions under the operator's existing Faraday workspace so the external bug-bounty pipeline joins the dispatcher's internal scanner output. Endpoints used: GET https://api.intigriti.com/external/researcher/v1/submissions?programId=<uuid>&statusId=<status>&limit=N&offset=M (paginated bug-bounty submission feed; canonical envelope is {'records': [{'id': '...', 'code': '...', 'title': '...', 'state': {'id': N, 'value': 'Open'}, 'severity': {'id': N, 'value': 'High'}, 'type': {'id': N, 'value': 'Vulnerability'}, 'endpoint': '...', 'programId': '...', 'researcher': {'username': '...'}, 'createdAt': 1234567890, 'lastUpdatedAt': 1234567890, ...}], 'maxCount': N} with each record carrying title, description / proofOfConcept, state (Open / Closed plus substate detail under state.value — Intigriti's published state machine includes New / Triage / Triaged / Accepted / Pending review / Resolved / Closed / Duplicate / Out of scope / Spam / Informative / Won't fix), severity (label or {'id': N, 'value': '...'} shape with the canonical Intigriti ladder Exceptional / Critical / High / Medium / Low / None / Informational), type (issue-type ontology with CWE mapping), endpoint (URL / asset the researcher targeted), programId (uuid pointer to the program), researcher.username, createdAt / lastUpdatedAt / closedAt (epoch seconds), bountyAmount / bountyCurrency (payout breakdown), cvssScore / cvssVector, cve (attributed CVE strings), cwe (attributed CWE strings, or a nested {'id': '...', 'value': '...'} shape)). Auth: Intigriti's Researcher API surface uses a single long-lived API token in the Authorization: Bearer <token> header (no username — the token alone is the identity). INTIG_HOST is an env-only override (defaults to https://api.intigriti.com); whitespace is trimmed and https:// is added when the operator pasted in a bare FQDN. Pagination is offset-based via limit=N + offset=M (Intigriti caps limit at 100); walks until len(records) < page_size or the env-only INTIG_PAGES knob is reached (default 10, clamped to [1, 100]). 401 short-circuits the whole executor (credentials are wrong); 403 / 429 / 5xx stop pagination and return what we have. Each Intigriti submission becomes one Faraday host with host.ip set to the 0.0.0.0 sentinel (bug-bounty submissions are keyed on a URL / asset path rather than an IP); the submission title and the endpoint URL land on host.hostnames; the submission itself becomes one Faraday vulnerability with the [BUG-BOUNTY] engine prefix so external researcher reports land alongside the other crowd-sourced feeds. Severity bucketing: Intigriti's published label vocabulary is Exceptional / Critical / High / Medium / Low / None / Informational; Exceptional collapses to Faraday's 'critical' bucket (Intigriti's most-severe rating sits above CVSS-style critical so the two collapse together for Faraday's ladder), None / Informational map to Faraday's 'info' bucket so the submission is still visible. The nested severity.value shape used in the canonical envelope is preferred; scalar label inputs are tolerated for federated mirrors that flatten the envelope. Closed / Resolved / Duplicate / Out-Of-Scope / Spam / Informative / Wont-Fix submissions are floored to 'info' regardless of the published rating (preserved via an explicit INTIG-Status pivot). Unparseable / missing severity defaults to 'info'. Status is always 'open' so the operator's remediation workflow takes over; the closed status is preserved via the info-severity floor + the INTIG-Status pivot. Refs include explicit INTIG-SubmissionID / INTIG-Code / INTIG-Program / INTIG-Researcher / INTIG-Status / INTIG-Type / INTIG-Severity / INTIG-CreatedAt / INTIG-UpdatedAt / INTIG-ClosedAt / INTIG-AcceptedAt / INTIG-ResolvedAt / INTIG-TriagedAt / INTIG-DisclosedAt / INTIG-Bounty / INTIG-Currency / INTIG-Source / INTIG-Endpoint / INTIG-CVSSVector / INTIG-CVSSScore pivots, plus the canonical https://app.intigriti.com/researcher/programs/<uuid> / https://app.intigriti.com/researcher/profile/<researcher> / https://app.intigriti.com/researcher/submissions/<id> permalinks and the canonical NVD CVE + MITRE CWE permalinks for any CVE / CWE ids surfaced in the cve / cwe / type / description / title fields. Tags: [intigriti, pentest-platforms, submission].
